Crestwood browse by type eq/excite/filter/wah wah wah fuzz-wah browse by enclosure treadle Crestwood 8-Tr Fuzz Wah Pedal Published on June 4, 2010 Crestwood fuzz-wah foot-controlled treadle Information The Crestwood 8-Tr Fuzz Wah is a 1970s OEM wah and fuzz combination pedal built by Shin-Ei and rebranded under names such as Crestwood, Jax, National, Companion, and Crown. It pairs a Shin-Ei 8Tr fuzz circuit with an onboard wah, delivering classic Super Fuzz-style tones with two selectable fuzz voices. The fuzz section employs an eight-transistor topology with two germanium diodes, while the wah provides a narrow, guitar-focused sweep. The pedal can operate as fuzz only, wah only, or fuzz and wah together, with simple controls for output level and fuzz intensity and a side switch to choose between two distinct fuzz textures. Controls Fuzz Volume: sets the output level of the fuzz Fuzz Adjust: sets the fuzz intensity/sustain Fuzz voice switch: two-position selector for different fuzz tones Wah footswitch: engages the wah circuit (treadle controlled) Fuzz footswitch: engages the fuzz circuit Treadle: controls the wah sweep Connections 1/4 in input jack 1/4 in output jack 9 V battery compartment Technical Specifications Circuit: Shin-Ei 8Tr fuzz (eight-transistor) with two germanium diodes Functions: fuzz, wah, or combined fuzz-wah Power: 9 V battery Era/Origin: 1970s, OEM by Shin-Ei (Japan) Highlights Super Fuzz-derived 8Tr circuit with two selectable fuzz voices Integrated wah with treadle control Simple, performance-oriented control layout Widely rebranded by Shin-Ei for multiple labels in the 1970s Reviews myFXDB user reviews No reviews yet  + Add your review Related Companion 6-Tr Fuzz-Wah (6-Tr, knobs on front) Alex Companion 6-Tr Fuzz-Wah Apollo 6-Tr Fuzz-Wah Crestwood 6-Tr Fuzz Wah Hohner FW-10 6-Tr Fuzz Wah Pedal Kent FW-3 6-Tr Fuzz Wah Maya 6-Tr Fuzz-Wah Mayfair 6-Tr Fuzz Wah Nomad (by Shin-Ei) 6-Tr Fuzz Wah Pax 6-Tr Fuzz Wah Sekova 6-Tr Fuzz-Wah Tempo 6-Tr Fuzz-Wah Zenta 6-Tr Fuzz Wah Shin-Ei WF-24 Fuzz Wah Pedal (8-Tr, wide box, knobs on top) Boomer WF-24 8-Tr Fuzz Wah Companion WF-24 8-Tr Fuzz Wah Electra 8-Tr Fuzz Wah Marlboro WF-24 8-Tr Fuzz Wah Oscar WF-24 8-Tr Fuzz Wah Shin-Ei Companion WF-24 8-Tr Fuzz Wah Thomas WF-24 8-Tr Fuzz Wah WEM WF-24 8-Tr Fuzz Wah Shin-Ei Companion WF-8 8
